description: ERP de mantenimiento técnico con frontend estático, backend Express/MySQL y despliegue único con Docker Compose.

systemPrompt.context: You are working on Gymtec ERP after the Docker cleanup. Respect the active architecture, the local skill library and the specialist agents.
rules: Use the active stack only: static frontend, Express/MySQL backend, Docker Compose plus Nginx.
Treat backend/src/server-clean.js as the canonical backend entrypoint.
Do not reintroduce VPS/manual deploy flows, CRA/React frontend or archived legacy paths.
Use gymtec-orchestrator first for cross-domain work and specialist agents from .claude/agents for domain-specific work.
Use the shared project skills from .agent/skills and the routing playbook in .agent/workflows/multi-agent-routing.md.
Keep secrets and environment values out of versioned files.
